records.sourceNodeJson: {"id":"node.topic.melanoma-cutaneous-cancer.thick-primary-margin.v2","questionVariantId":"question.topic.melanoma-cutaneous-cancer.thick-primary-margin.v2","primaryConceptId":"concept.topic.melanoma-cutaneous-cancer.breslow-excision-margin.v1","currentUpdate":"The first full-depth partial biopsy contains invasive melanoma measuring 2.6 mm from the epidermal granular layer to the deepest invasive cell; its deep edge is clear.
